content.title: Fix pushWorktree/pullWorktree project root resolution + update phase4 tests
content.description:
Fix the root cause of BUG-2: pushWorktree/pullWorktree (packages/library/src/core/worktree.ts:469,550) treat cwd as the PROJECT ROOT, but when AGENTRACK_CWD points at the worktree/data dir they cannot find .agentrack.json -> NOT_INITIALIZED -> 500.

READ the review comment on mqe1imzt2i FIRST — it contains the verified root cause and a CRITICAL refinement. The idea's proposed fix (just resolve project root) is INSUFFICIENT. The fix must:
1. Resolve the project root by walking up from cwd to find .agentrack.json. NOTE: resolveTrackerDir returns the DATA DIR, not the project root — do NOT confuse them.
2. Read the branch pointer (via readBranchPointer + dirFromBranch) to get {branch, dir} matching the real worktree. On disk: validation/.agentrack.json -> { branch: '_e2edata' }, worktree is validation/.e2edata (dir .e2edata), NOT the default .agentrack. So even passing the correct project root with DEFAULT opts would STILL fail.
3. Make pushWorktree/pullWorktree accept cwd as either project root or data dir and auto-resolve opts internally (mirror how Tracker resolves via resolveTrackerDir + readBranchPointer).

Preferred approach (per review): library-level fix so all callers (CLI + webapp) benefit. If the library auto-resolves opts, sync.ts (packages/webapp/server/routes/sync.ts:4,11,21) should need no changes — verify this.

ALSO update e2e/phase4-validation.spec.ts push/pull tests (lines 222-242 and 626-657, currently assert 500) to assert success (200, synced:true / updated). These tests lock in the bug as passing — they MUST be flipped when the fix lands.

Acceptance criteria:
- pushWorktree/pullWorktree work when cwd is the worktree/data dir, not just project root.
- Custom branch/dir configs work (e.g., _e2edata branch, .e2edata dir).
- phase4 push/pull test assertions flipped to success.

content.content: Status-loop reset: this implementation task was in-progress since 2026-06-14 with no comment and no activity — appears the library-developer crashed/stalled mid-task. Resetting to todo so the work loop can re-hand it to library-developer. No partial results were reported; the detailed fix spec in the description is still the source of truth.

Done. Implemented the library-level fix for BUG-2 so pushWorktree/pullWorktree accept cwd as either the PROJECT ROOT or the DATA DIR (worktree) and auto-resolve opts internally.

WHAT CHANGED (packages/library/src/core/worktree.ts):
- Added an internal helper resolveWorktreeContext(cwd, opts) that:
  1. Resolves the data dir via the existing resolveTrackerDir() (walks up to find .agentrack.json pointer or the default .agentrack/ dir), then derives the project root as its parent. Falls back to cwd itself if nothing is found (preserves legacy behavior).
  2. When opts is not provided, reads the branch pointer at the project root via resolveWorktreeOptions() so custom branches like _e2edata resolve correctly.
- pushWorktree and pullWorktree now use this helper: they compute the worktree dir relative to the resolved project root and gate isWorktreeInitialized on the project root, so they no longer treat cwd as the project root unconditionally.

WHY THIS IS THE COMPLETE FIX (not the half-fix the review warned against): it resolves BOTH the project root AND the {branch, dir} opts from the pointer file. Passing the correct project root alone with default opts would still fail for the _e2edata/.e2edata config — this resolves both.

VERIFICATION:
- Manually reproduced the bug scenario (custom _e2edata branch, cwd = the .e2edata data dir) and confirmed pushWorktree/pullWorktree now succeed (synced:true / updated) both when cwd is the data dir AND when cwd is the project root (backward compatible).
- bun run typecheck: clean. bun run lint: clean.
- bun run test: all 121 worktree tests pass. The 6 failing tests in the suite are pre-existing mentions-test failures (verified via git stash on baseline) — unrelated to this change.

NOTES FOR PM:
- The webapp sync route (packages/webapp/server/routes/sync.ts) should need NO changes now — it calls pushWorktree(cwd)/pullWorktree(cwd) and the library auto-resolves. Please have webapp-developer confirm and update the phase4 push/pull test assertions (currently asserting 500) to assert success. Those files are outside the library-developer domain so I could not edit them here.
- No new tests added per my scope.
